question: The hairy cell leukemia (hairy cell leukemia) presents as characteristic clinical-biological features:

options.opa: Lymphocytosis in peripheral blood greater than 50,000 lymphocytes / microL.
options.opc: Exfoliative generalized erythroderma, plaques and skin tumors.

analysis: Hairy cell leukemia is a rare type of chronic leukemia characterized by the presence of abnormal B lymphocytes with 'hairy' projections. The disease typically presents with pancytopenia (a reduction in red and white blood cells and platelets) and splenomegaly (enlargement of the spleen). These features are due to the infiltration of the bone marrow and spleen by the leukemic cells. The other options do not align with the typical presentation of hairy cell leukemia.
